title: FuelTech Boost Controller & Dashboard
tag_line: FuelTech-inspired boost controller and full-screen telemetry dashboard for turbo, supercharged, and NA cars.
message:
FuelTech Boost Controller & Dashboard

A FuelTech-inspired boost controller with a full-screen telemetry dashboard. Works with turbo, supercharged, and naturally aspirated vehicles.

========================================
INSTALLATION — PLEASE READ
========================================

Most "doesn't show up" issues are install problems. Follow these steps exactly.

1. DOWNLOAD the .zip file. Do NOT extract it.

2. DROP THE ZIP into your BeamNG mods folder:
     %LocalAppData%\BeamNG.drive\<version>\mods\

   How to get there: paste %LocalAppData%\BeamNG.drive into File Explorer, open the version folder (e.g. 0.34 or 0.35), then open the "mods" folder. Drop the zip inside.

3. LAUNCH BeamNG and spawn any turbo or supercharged car.

4. ENABLE THE PART on the vehicle:
   - Press Esc → Vehicle Config (or press Ctrl+W)
   - Find "FuelTech Boost Controller" under "Additional Modification"
   - Click to add it, then Save

   Without this step the dashboard will spawn but the boost controller will not work — your car will blow past the limiter.

5. ADD THE DASHBOARD to your screen:
   - Press Esc → UI Apps (bottom left of the menu)
   - Search for "FuelTech Dashboard"
   - Click it once to drop it on screen
   - DRAG THE EDGES to resize. The HUD fills whatever area you give it — make it small for a corner overlay or large for a full dashboard view.

Still not showing up?
- Make sure the zip is in the correct version folder (it must match the version of BeamNG you are running).
- Make sure no other mod is using the N2O part slot — that's where this controller installs.
- Try the "unpacked" workflow: extract the zip into mods\unpacked\fueltech_boost_controller\ instead.

========================================
ROADMAP
========================================

Planned for upcoming versions:
- Simpler, cleaner UI with less visual clutter
- Remove the N2O part slot requirement so the controller installs automatically on every vehicle (no Vehicle Config step needed)
- Better defaults so the mod "just works" out of the box

Feedback and suggestions are welcome — drop a comment on the mod page.

========================================
USING THE BOOST CONTROLLER
========================================

Presets (top of the dashboard):
- OFF — zero boost (acts like NA)
- STOCK — factory boost levels
- MAX — maximum hardware boost
- AUTO MAX — calculates max safe boost per RPM (stays under engine torque limit)
- CUSTOM — drag the orange dots on the boost map to tune by RPM
- OVERBOOST (red) — bypasses the turbo's hardware limit. Use with care.

Other features:
- Boost-by-gear: reduce boost in lower gears for traction
- Save/load boost profiles per vehicle
- Automatic safety cut if coolant > 115°C or oil > 135°C
- Closed-loop PI controller targets actual measured boost

========================================
DASHBOARD FEATURES
========================================

- Large RPM gauge with redline zone
- Boost PSI gauge (auto-scales to your turbo's max)
- Live power and torque curves vs stock (HP & Nm)
- Oil temp, coolant temp, EGT, throttle, fuel, engine load
- G-force meter and 0-100 / 0-200 km/h drag timer
- Per-wheel brake temperatures with color coding
- Damage log: engine, brakes, tires, drivetrain
- Auto-detected diff lock, AWD, range box, ESC / TCS / ABS toggles
- Shift light at 90% redline + turbo timer cooldown

On NA cars the boost controls auto-hide and the dashboard becomes a universal telemetry HUD.

========================================
COMPATIBILITY
========================================

- BeamNG.drive 0.34+
- Turbocharged, supercharged, and naturally aspirated vehicles
- Touch support (Steam Deck / touchscreen)
